rootCause: The canonical BAT runtime template centercut-item-load-work omits parent_segment_id while all generated vendor query leaves currently contain it after F276. A later official regeneration would silently remove the required lineage field.
impact: Header6/CEC lineage could regress during DB3 regeneration even though current generated leaves pass.
requiredFix: Currentize the canonical template, regenerate all DB3 query packs, and assert template/vendor byte parity plus exact Work mapping.
